rv.q: For lovers of Macbeth, “What the Weird Sisters Saw” is in fascinating conversation with Shakespeare’s original text.
Highly recommended, "What the Weird Sisters Saw" will play at The Edge Off-Broadway Theatre through April 14, 2024 .
Jackson's homage to Macbeth's witches is inventive.
It’s a two-act drama filled with magic, mystery and mist that will intrigue and delight fans of Shakespeare’s 1606 tragedy, especially its female audiences.
While gaining this background knowledge is certainly helpful in understanding the motivation behind the characters, the totality wasn’t as satisfying as I thought it would be.
The result is a lackluster production that fails to live up to its intriguing premise.

cn.t: This reimagining of Macbeth from the witches' perspective earns mostly positive reviews for its inventive concept, though one critic finds the execution lackluster. The creative approach to Shakespeare's tragedy generally impresses.
